n: Stanford CRAFT AI social studies collection
t: Six history and social science lessons about AI from Stanford CRAFT.
steps: Find the Stanford CRAFT social studies collection on the Stanford GSE site.
Pick one of the six lessons that fits your unit.
Print the organizers and prepare the slides.
Check whether the lesson asks students to use an AI search tool.
Ask IT about any outside site you plan to use.
Plan the lesson for 60 to 75 minutes.
